topIssues.title: OPCMUpgradeV800: Fix for the simplified SUPER_PERMISSIONED game
topIssues.author: Inphi
topIssues.body:
The V800 template does not support the simplified SUPER_PERMISSIONED_GAME type because that game args structure has changed. Since SUPER_PERMISSIONED_GAME hasn't shipped yet, we should just replace the old game args with the simplified one.

The abi encoded game args structure for the simplified super permissioned game can be found here - https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/423d93e6374a65f3a83c1ed5e29c5998c972a5da/packages/contracts-bedrock/interfaces/L1/opcm/IOPContractsManagerUtils.sol#L39C1-L41C6.

topPRs.title: eth/071: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — OP Mainnet, Ink, Soneium, Unichain
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Stacked on #1502 (the OPCMUpgradeV800 template). 

Mainnet counterpart of #1536: adds `src/tasks/eth/071-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni`, U20 on mainnet chains, using the **op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3** OPCM on Mainnet at [`0x1951828ce913dc4383a8a1695695d537a11d896a`](https://etherscan.io/address/0x1951828ce913dc4383a8a1695695d537a11d896a) (version `8.0.1`, per superchain-registry `standard-versions-mainnet.toml`).

| Chain | Chain ID | Rotates to |
|---|---|---|
| OP Mainnet | 10 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Ink | 57073 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Soneium | 1868 | SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5, permissioned-only — stayed permissioned in U19, no CANNON_KONA impl to carry over) |
| Unichain | 130 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |

One transaction from the standard Mainnet L1PAO `0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A` (2-of-2 Foundation Upgrade Safe + Security Council).

## Sequencing
- Stacked after the two pending mmzd tasks (`eth/067`, `eth/068`).
- Also sequenced after the Unichain PAO transition (`eth/069`/`eth/070` on `main`, DRAFT, gated on the Unichain governance vote). Those execute from the Unichain 3-of-3 (`0x6d5B...5833`) — no L1PAO nonce impact — but FUS and SC are child signers of that 3-of-3, so each consumes one FUS and one SC nonce. Pins are therefore L1PAO 42 (live 40 + 2), FUS 70 (66 + 4), SC 68 (64 + 4), and stay consistent whether or not 069/070 are present in the simulated tree.
- **`eth/069` MUST execute on-chain before signing** (it hands Unichain's L1 ProxyAdmin + DisputeGameFactory to the standard L1PAO). Simulation reproduces the post-069 state via owner-slot state overrides plus the `[addresses] ProxyAdminOwner` pin.

## Draft — blocking before signing
- [ ] All four `startingAnchorRootRoot` values are placeholders (`0xdead...`) and MUST be replaced with each chain's honest super root + timestamp, then re-simulated and VALIDATION.md hashes regenerated.
- [ ] `eth/069`/`eth/070` executed on-chain (governance-gated), ideally with a registry pin update, then Unichain's `expectedValidationErrors` re-captured.
- [ ] `eth/067`/`eth/068` executed (or pins re-derived); live nonces re-verified at signing time.

topPRs.title: sep/110: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — OP, Ink, Soneium, Unichain Sepolia
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Stacked on #1502 (the finalized OPCMUpgradeV800 template set). 

Adds `src/tasks/sep/110-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni` U20 on Sepolia chains, using the **op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3** OPCM deployed on Sepolia at [`0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca) (version `8.0.1`).

| Chain | Chain ID | Rotates to |
|---|---|---|
| OP Sepolia Testnet | 11155420 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Ink Sepolia | 763373 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Soneium Testnet Minato | 1946 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| Unichain Sepolia Testnet | 1301 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |

One transaction from the standard OP-governed Sepolia L1PAO `0x1Eb2fFc903729a0F03966B917003800b145F56E2` (2-of-2 Foundation Upgrade Safe + Security Council).

## Sequencing
- Stacked after the two pending mmzd tasks (`sep/105`, `sep/106`); nonce pins are the post-106 values (L1PAO 56, FUS 76, SC 70 — live values 54/74/68 on 2026-09-02).
- **External dependency:** Unichain Sepolia's PAO transfer from `0xd363...9dbf` to the standard L1PAO is executed by the Unichain Safe outside this repo (no signer overlap → no nonce impact here), and MUST land on-chain before signing. Simulation reproduces the post-transfer state via state overrides on Unichain's L1 ProxyAdmin (slot 0) and DisputeGameFactory (slot 0x33) owners, plus a `[addresses] ProxyAdminOwner` root-safe pin (same pattern as `sep/106`).

## Draft — blocking before signing
- [ ] All four `startingAnchorRootRoot` values are placeholders (`0xdead...`) and MUST be replaced with each chain's honest super root + timestamp, then re-simulated and VALIDATION.md hashes regenerated.
- [ ] Unichain PAO transfer executed on-chain (and ideally the registry pin updated, then `expectedValidationErrors` for 1301 re-captured).
- [ ] `sep/105` and `sep/106` executed (or nonce pins re-derived), live nonces re-verified at signing time.

topPRs.author: Wazabie

Adds `src/tasks/sep/109-U20-sepolia-devnet-2-3` U20 on OP devnets, using the **op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3** OPCM deployed on Sepolia at [`0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca) (version `8.0.1`, per superchain-registry `standard-versions-sepolia.toml`)

Executes as a single transaction from the shared devnet ProxyAdminOwner Safe `0xe934Dc97E347C6aCef74364B50125bb8689c40ff` (1-of-1), nonce pinned at the live value (140).

- [ ] Devnet PAO Safe nonce (140) re-verified against chain at signing time.

topPRs.title: feat: re-add OPCM V800 templates with simplified super-permissioned args
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
> **Draft — do not merge until the V800 OPCM is deployed on-chain.**

Re-adds the `OPCMUpgradeV800` and `OPCMMigrateV800` templates, their integration tests, and example tasks that were removed in #1501, now carrying the simplified super-permissioned game arg layout from #1500.

Stacked on #1501 (base branch `centaur/remove-opcm-v800-templates`). GitHub will retarget this to `main` once #1501 merges.

## What changed vs the original V800 templates
`OPCMUpgradeV800` encodes `SUPER_PERMISSIONED_CANNON` (gt=5) game args as **proposer-only** (`abi.encode(a.proposer)`, 32 bytes) instead of the old `abi.encode(absolutePrestate, proposer, challenger)`, matching the simplified op-contracts V800 ABI. Test coverage in `SuperRootUpgrade.t.sol` is updated accordingly, and `test_upgrade_sepolia()` is dropped because the forked OPCM predates the new layout. This is the exact diff from #1500.

## Why draft
V800 is not yet deployed on-chain, so `template_regression_tests` cannot simulate `035-opcm-upgrade-v800` against a compatible OPCM — it reverts in `_build`. By removing the templates from `main` (#1501) and re-adding the new version here, we avoid carrying a backwards-compatibility shim for a not-yet-live OPCM. Once V800 is deployed: merge #1501, then mark this ready and merge.

Closes #1466 (once merged)

Prompted by: @mds1

topPRs.title: Add Unichain mainnet PAO transition tasks (eth/069-070)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Transitions the Unichain Mainnet (chainId 130) ProxyAdmin Owner to the standard OP-governed model per the [governance post](https://app.notion.com/p/oplabs/EXTERNAL-Maintenance-Upgrade-Proposal-Unichain-ProxyAdmin-Owner-Transition-to-Standard-Optimism-Go-381f153ee16281efad21c307cef7c928): eth/069 transfers the L1 `ProxyAdmin` and `DisputeGameFactory` from the Unichain 3-of-3 to the standard L1PAO (`TransferOwners`), then eth/070 moves the L2 `ProxyAdmin` predeploy to the aliased L1PAO via a portal deposit sent by the 3-of-3 (`TransferL2PAOFromL1`). Same flow as eth/063/064 on Swell, signed by the 3-of-3's `chain-governor`/`foundation`/`council` child safes. Both tasks are DRAFT until the special voting cycle and veto period complete; all addresses are sourced from the superchain-registry (links in the task docs).

Everything else on Unichain is already standard or out of scope: Guardian, Challenger and SuperchainConfig are the OP Mainnet ones, DelayedWETH is post-U16 and not ownable, and the SystemConfig owner stays with the operator per the governance post. Sepolia is covered by the same proposal but not part of this PR.

Two drive-bys: eth/065 is marked EXECUTED ([tx](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xbf75cc41981ecb8481f3b114697310490b72f96c74fcc34e33b57433b6d9e756)) — its stale READY-TO-SIGN status broke the eth stacked simulation — and `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` step 9 now shows the correct example `From` address.

Note: the FUS/SC nonce pins overlap with #1521 (both stack after eth/066); whichever set of tasks signs second must re-pin and re-simulate.
